constraints: Use authorized generated ordinary prime-order curves over prime fields.
Separate one-time fixed-curve advice and offline construction from per-target work, bandwidth, live state, and success probability.
Every positive node predicate must be exact and lift to five signed public factor identifiers whose affine sum is independently verified.
The positive path may not materialize all D2 target bits, a translated D3 polynomial, or a supported-target table.
No implementation or execution is authorized while the contract is REVIEW_REQUIRED.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether an exact coordinate-specific subset-norm operator can navigate D2 intersect (Q-D3) with advice below explicit D3 and online work below an exact D2 scan, and whether any passing fixed-curve result survives full generic-frontier and ECDLP-pipeline accounting.
research_question.motivation: A resultant or gcd against a subset product gives an exact subtree nonemptiness predicate, so one witness needs only a root-to-leaf trace if each predicate can be answered compactly. The unproved step is an exact target-conditioned block-Hankel, approximant, or displacement generator that avoids emitting one value per D2 leaf.

curve_families: fixed generated ordinary prime-order short-Weierstrass curves

research_question.title: Exact subset-norm navigation for a fixed-curve relation compiler
